prompts: We need a landing page, {WS}/landing/index.html in a single file, for the story of Piet Mondrian's "Composition with Red, Blue and Yellow" (1930). The facts are in {WS}/FACTSHEET.md, and nothing beyond them should be claimed. A visitor should leave knowing the painter, the year, the movement and why the work matters, and be invited to read more at the source the fact sheet gives. The page itself should speak Mondrian's visual language. It is reviewed by opening the file, with no build step, in a browser that reaches only Google Fonts and https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/three@0.170.0/build/three.module.js.
answers:
**[goal]** Build a single-file landing page, `landing/index.html`, about Mondrian's 1930 painting. It uses only facts from FACTSHEET.md and links to the source.

**[action]**
- Wrote one HTML file with inline CSS and no build step. Only one thing is loaded from outside: Google Fonts (Archivo / Archivo Black). If the fonts don't load, the page falls back to Helvetica/Arial.
- The visual language follows the fact sheet's rules: black gaps act as thick black lines, and the layout is only horizontal and vertical blocks in red, blue, yellow, white, grey and black. The opening screen copies the painting's layout: a big red block at top right, blue at bottom left, yellow at bottom right.
- Content in order: painter, year, movement (De Stijl, its founders, the Neoplasticism rules), the other title, a description of the picture, why it matters, and a button linking to the Wikipedia source. Every claim is reworded from the fact sheet and adds nothing new.

**Assumptions:**
- I left out Three.js on purpose. Mondrian's language is flat and orthogonal, so 3D adds nothing and would be one more thing that can fail.
- The page is an homage built from CSS blocks, not a reproduction of the painting, and the footer says so.
- Mobile layout switches below 760px.

**[result]**
- A grep for "Kunsthaus Zurich", "1930" and "De Stijl" found 9 matching lines, so the key facts are on the page.
- I checked the facts by hand, line by line against FACTSHEET.md.
- **I did not open the page in a browser**, so the rendering and the mobile layout are unchecked. No browser windows or apps were opened.

**[next]** Open `landing/index.html` in a browser at desktop and phone widths to check the layout.
